mandatory_legal_checks: Copyright Act 1957 S.19(1) — assignment INVALID unless in writing signed by the assignor
Copyright Act 1957 S.19(5) — no stated period means FIVE YEARS only
Copyright Act 1957 S.19(6) — no stated territory means INDIA only
Copyright Act 1957 S.19(4) — lapses after one year if the assignee does not exercise the rights, unless stated otherwise
Copyright Act 1957 S.57 — moral rights CANNOT be assigned and survive the assignment
Copyright Act 1957 S.17 — a contractor retains copyright absent a written assignment; only an employee's work vests in the employer
Patents Act 1970 S.68 — assignment must be a single document embodying ALL terms and conditions
Trade Marks Act 1999 S.45 — record the assignment with the Registrar or it is ineffective against third parties
